conventions.pale_blue: Bambu PETG Translucent Clear 32101 shell; diagrammatic shading, not pigment or a prediction of optical clarity
conventions.gray_tile: cropped build plate, not full printer bed

hero.caption: Finished float beside a section through its axis. Pale blue shading identifies the clear PETG shell.

finished.caption: Finished PETG Translucent Clear 32101 float with its open guide bore. The clear shell is shaded pale blue for visibility.

section.caption: The continuous clear PETG envelope surrounds both Aero pieces and the ring magnet. Pale blue distinguishes PETG from the white Aero.

exploded.caption: Open PETG shell, lower Aero core, ring magnet and upper Aero insert. The roof prints in place after insertion.

parts.caption: Cooled Aero core, upper insert and one RC62 ring magnet.

plate-aero.caption: Two separate plate crops: core on plate 1, upper insert on plate 2. Both print upright.

plate-core.caption: Aero core upright, flat bottom down and magnet pocket up.

plate-insert.caption: Aero upper insert flat on its annular face.

plate-petg.caption: PETG shell upright on the textured plate; its roof is completed after the pause.

magnet-seat.caption: Seat the RC62 ring in the upward-facing recess of the cooled Aero core.

magnet-seated.caption: The ring sits inside the core's top recess, leaving the central bore clear.

paused-shell.caption: The shell pauses with its outer and bore walls at 57 mm and its roof still open. Cutaway view.

core-in.caption: Lower the core and its seated magnet over the PETG bore tube. Cutaway shell.

core-seated.caption: The core stands on the PETG floor, with its magnet at the top. Cutaway view.

insert-in.caption: Lower the upper Aero insert over the bore tube and onto the core. Cutaway shell and core.

insert-push.caption: Use the upper insert to press the prepared core down evenly until the insert is level with the PETG rim. Cutaway view.

roof-ready.caption: The top of the upper insert is flush with the PETG rim. Cutaway view.

roof.caption: Seventeen PETG layers close the roof over the supported insert. Cutaway view.

lead-in-detail.caption: Underside detail: the 0.5 mm outer and inner lead-ins start the core into the PETG shell. Both Aero pieces have these lower-edge chamfers.

flush-detail.caption: At the pause, the upper insert is level with the shell rim and bore lining. The guide bore stays clear. Cropped cutaway.
